checks.finding: Each of REQ-001..REQ-006 specifies concrete, measurable behavior (exact exit codes, schema field sets, ordering rules, VERDICT states) rather than intent statements. E.g. REQ-002's second-argument-omitted vs. second-argument-supplied-and-invalid distinction (requirements.md ~354-379) is measurable via AC-007 (byte-identical output) and AC-027 (exit 2, no trigger output); REQ-004's unmapped-check-id rule (~521-536) is measurable via AC-016's VERDICT:FAIL vs N/A distinction. No in-scope requirement relies on unmeasurable language.

Every REQ-001..REQ-006 goal has at least one matching AC: REQ-001->AC-001..006,029; REQ-002->AC-007..010,027,028; REQ-003->AC-011..013,026,030; REQ-004->AC-014..018,026; REQ-005->AC-019..021; REQ-006->AC-022. acceptance-tests.md's own AC-022/TEST-022 additionally cross-checks fixture-to-AC coverage as a self-audit.

Acceptance criteria specify externally observable outputs rather than vague intent: AC-008 specifies exact triggers= token ordering and exit code 10; AC-016 specifies VERDICT:FAIL with a stated reason vs. N/A; AC-026 specifies Step 2a blocking before Step 2b on a named field value. The design-content-review class (AC-020/022/029) is explicitly labeled as such in the Spec-Authoring-Time Manual Review Record (acceptance-tests.md lines 56-110), not conflated with automated-fixture rows.

requirements.md's Non-goals section explicitly excludes contracts/**, plugins/**, scripts/**, tests/**, .github/**, docs/** edits in this Phase 1 commit; excludes reimplementing A2's evaluate-predicate, A3's resolve-component-paths, and A5's Resolver pipeline; fixes the lite-check-catalog seed at exactly three tokens; and excludes building sdd-delivery/Artifact/Promotion Gates. Boundaries are stated affirmatively, not left implicit.

Migration rule is explicit (REQ-001 item 3: v1 Registry instances stay schema-valid, required_lite_checks defaults to []). Security Boundaries section enumerates every fail-closed condition (unrecognized catalog token, schema-invalid Summary, absent Summary under active enforcement, full_upgrade_required:true, unmapped check-id, invalid capability-reasons fragment). Approval/protected-file boundaries are explicit and differentiated (REQ-002/REQ-005 human-copy vs. REQ-004 direct edit, each citing live guard-invariants.json evidence and a re-verification obligation at implementation-start time).

The Risks section names four concrete risks, each with a stated validation/mitigation path: the A5-Pending field-naming/aggregation-rule risk is tracked via AC-029/TEST-029 as an explicit cross-epic contract; the intake-time-Block defense-in-depth limitation is covered by the existing mandatory ship-time recheck (REQ-005, Main Workflows step 6); the ADR-prose-to-token mapping and catalog-seed-narrowness risks are both addressed via the catalog's additive catalog_version growth mechanism (REQ-001 item 5) plus an explicitly named future spec-review pass as the manual-inspection validation surface.
